trailhead.label: Campello Monti (1,305 m), the Region’s start

cautions: 620 m up and 750 m down over a 1,924 m pass: check the weather.
Stony, steep hairpins below the Alpe Scarpia.
Grazing pastures on both sides of the pass in summer: Rimella asks for a short lead near flocks, no stepping between flock and guard dog, and the widest possible berth.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.620 m up and 750 m down over a 1,924 m p: 620 m di salita e 750 m di discesa oltre un passo a 1.924 m: controlla il meteo.
textIt.Stony, steep hairpins below the Alpe Sca: Tornanti ripidi e sassosi sotto l'Alpe Scarpia.
textIt.Grazing pastures on both sides of the pa: D'estate pascoli in uso su entrambi i versanti del passo: Rimella chiede guinzaglio corto vicino alle greggi, di non mettersi mai tra il gregge e il cane da guardiania e di stare il più possibile alla larga.
